protocol.half_degree_method: Linear interpolation between recurrence values at the bracketing integer degrees. Not int() truncation.
protocol.noise: targets = sin(degrees) + sigma * z, sigma in [0.0, 0.0001, 0.001]. z is one standard-normal vector per training set from Generator(0).
protocol.selection: Minimize training mean square error after local Nelder-Mead. Starts within 1e-18 of the lowest loss are one tie. chosen_by_train_loss is the earliest fixed start in that tie and is list order, not an identified frequency. raw_argmin_train_loss is the float minimum and can differ by dust. Test error is not an input.
protocol.scaled_sine_coordinate_error: held-out mean |prediction - sin| multiplied by 3438. This is a scaled sine coordinate, not an angle in arcminutes.
protocol.integer_grid: A near-zero error on integer degrees is the recurrence evaluated on its own step. It does not transfer to half degrees.
protocol.root_benchmark: All-nines operands favor the descending digit search, because 9 is tried first and succeeds. This pass does not repeat that timing.
